title: Layered tin halide perovskites in photovoltaics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00560D, Review Article
Mengqiong Zhu, Bhumika Chaudhary, Anamika Mishra, Michael Saliba, Jovana V. Milić
Layered tin halide perovskites are emerging as promising alternatives to traditional lead-based materials. We provide a comprehensive overview of their characteristics, synthesis methods, and applications for environmentally friendly photovoltaics.
